abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Cardivel lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide improves systolic drop compared with Standard care.
conclusion: In the end, the evidence on each measure reads like this. Overall, Cardivel lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide improves systolic drop compared with Standard care.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Northgate Heart Cohort.

Table 6. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 14.1 | 7.0 | 300 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 10.4 | 5.2 | 300 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 17.7 | 8.8 | 300 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
